config.output_condition: Floating NCHW; dilation-aware convolution or explicit transposed/multi-stage geometry. See parameter_dependencies and preflight.
compatibility: HYSo/PyTorch component; CPU construction only.
Builder v1: linear connections; no external skip/concat/DAG.
BatchNorm requires N*H*W>1 while training; GroupNorm requires valid group statistics.
SE/CBAM keep max(1, channels//reduction); CBAM/ECA kernels must be odd.
Serialization saves architecture only, not trained weights or optimizer state.
common_errors: Match incoming channels and group divisors.
Use positive output geometry including every internal stage.

basic.tr: Conv2d sonucuna seçilen normalizasyonu ve aktivasyonu sırayla uygular. Group seçeneği en çok sekiz olan en büyük kanal bölenini kullanır.
basic.en: Applies the selected normalization and activation after Conv2d. Group normalization uses the largest channel divisor at most eight.

config.example:
from hyso.models import GraphModelBuilder
config = {'format': 'hyso.model_config',
 'schema_version': 3,
 'kind': 'graph',
 'inputs': {'image': {'shape': [4, 8, 8],
                      'layout': 'NCHW',
                      'dtype': 'floating',
                      'device': 'model'}},
 'nodes': [{'id': 'example',
            'component': 'conv_norm_act',
            'inputs': ['image'],
            'params': {'in_channels': 4,
                       'out_channels': 4,
                       'kernel_size': [3, 3],
                       'stride': [1, 1],
                       'padding': [1, 1],
                       'groups': 1,
                       'norm': 'batch',
                       'activation': 'silu'}}],
 'outputs': {'result': 'example'}}
builder = GraphModelBuilder.from_config(config)
report = builder.preflight(config)
assert report['valid']
model = builder.build()

config.name: dropblock2d

config.example:
from hyso.models import GraphModelBuilder
config = {'format': 'hyso.model_config',
 'schema_version': 3,
 'kind': 'graph',
 'inputs': {'image': {'shape': [4, 8, 8],
                      'layout': 'NCHW',
                      'dtype': 'floating',
                      'device': 'model'}},
 'nodes': [{'id': 'example',
            'component': 'preactivation_residual',
            'inputs': ['image'],
            'params': {'in_channels': 4,
                       'out_channels': 4,
                       'intermediate_channels': 4,
                       'kernel_size': 3,
                       'stride': [1, 1],
                       'dilation': [1, 1],
                       'normalization': 'batch',
                       'activation': 'silu',
                       'attention': 'none',
                       'dropout': 0.0,
                       'drop_path': 0.0}}],
 'outputs': {'result': 'example'}}
builder = GraphModelBuilder.from_config(config)
report = builder.preflight(config)
assert report['valid']
model = builder.build()

from hyso.models import GraphModelBuilder
config = {'format': 'hyso.model_config',
 'schema_version': 3,
 'kind': 'graph',
 'inputs': {'image': {'shape': [4, 8, 8],
                      'layout': 'NCHW',
                      'dtype': 'floating',
                      'device': 'model'}},
 'nodes': [{'id': 'example',
            'component': 'inverted_bottleneck',
            'inputs': ['image'],
            'params': {'in_channels': 4,
                       'out_channels': 4,
                       'expansion_ratio': 2,
                       'kernel_size': 3,
                       'stride': [1, 1],
                       'dilation': [1, 1],
                       'normalization': 'batch',
                       'activation': 'silu',
                       'attention': 'none',
                       'dropout': 0.0,
                       'drop_path': 0.0}}],
 'outputs': {'result': 'example'}}
builder = GraphModelBuilder.from_config(config)
report = builder.preflight(config)
assert report['valid']
model = builder.build()

from hyso.models import GraphModelBuilder
config = {'format': 'hyso.model_config',
 'schema_version': 3,
 'kind': 'graph',
 'inputs': {'image': {'shape': [4, 8, 8],
                      'layout': 'NCHW',
                      'dtype': 'floating',
                      'device': 'model'}},
 'nodes': [{'id': 'example',
            'component': 'regression_head',
            'inputs': ['image'],
            'params': {'in_features': 4,
                       'pooling': 'avg',
                       'output_features': 2}}],

builder = GraphModelBuilder.from_config(config)
report = builder.preflight(config)
assert report['valid']
model = builder.build()

basic.tr: Sıralı girdileri ham ağırlıklarıyla çarpıp toplar. Softmax veya toplam-bir normalizasyonu yoktur. Ağırlıklar sabit buffer veya öğrenilebilir parametredir.
basic.en: Sums ordered inputs multiplied by raw weights. There is no softmax or sum-to-one normalization. Weights are fixed buffers or learnable parameters.

config.example:
from hyso.models import GraphModelBuilder
config = {'format': 'hyso.model_config',
 'schema_version': 3,
 'kind': 'graph',
 'inputs': {'image': {'shape': [4, 8, 8],
                      'layout': 'NCHW',
                      'dtype': 'floating',
                      'device': 'model'},
            'skip': {'shape': [4, 8, 8],
                     'layout': 'NCHW',
                     'dtype': 'floating',
                     'device': 'model'}},
 'nodes': [{'id': 'example',
            'component': 'weighted_sum',
            'inputs': ['image', 'skip'],
            'params': {'weights': [1, 1], 'learnable': False}}],
 'outputs': {'result': 'example'}}
builder = GraphModelBuilder.from_config(config)
report = builder.preflight(config)
assert report['valid']
model = builder.build()
